api_description:
getRedYellowGreenState(string) -> string

Returns the named tl's state as a tuple of light definitions from
rugGyYoO, for red, yed-yellow, green, yellow, off, where lower case letters mean that the stream
has to decelerate.
engineer_description: What the signal at one intersection shows right now, movement by movement, and how long until it changes. intersection: cross streets, e.g. "Fowler & McKinley" (see list_intersections). Returns, for each approach (EB, WB, NB or SB, the direction of travel), the indication of its through, left and right movements: green; green but yield to conflicting traffic (a permissive left, for example); stop, then go if clear (right turn on red); yellow; or red. Then the seconds until the signal changes (a countdown, not a clock time). Reads only: time does not pass and nothing changes. A reading outside the analysis hour (900-4500 s) carries a WARM-UP or AFTER-PEAK warning. Use get_signal_plan for the whole cycle; this tool shows one moment of it.
engineer_result:
E Fowler Ave & McKinley Dr at 1805 s: the signal changes in 30 s.
  NB: through red; left red; right red
  EB: through green
  WB: through green; left red
